msg: The gnomes will appear in fixed pairs - their positions may vary but they will always be in the same pairs. These pairs are blue/purple, red/yellow, green/pink, and orange/brown. Each gnome will lead you to a different forest - one is bright with a red basket, and the other is dark with a yellow basket. Orange/green/red/blue take you to the bright forest, and brown/pink/yellow/purple take you to the dark forest.You must get to the forest that has the most mushrooms. This may change throughout the game, but generally if you're getting to a forest that is giving you 7/8/9 mushrooms, then keep trying to get to that forest until it stops giving you high numbers. I haven't quite worked out when/why it changes, but the forest which gives you the most mushrooms does change throughout the game. Everything else bar the colour of the gnome's hat is irrelevant as far as I can see. Good luck!
